questions.code_template:

    cube = n ** 3
    print(f"{n}: square={___}, cube={___}")

1: square=1, cube=1
2: square=4, cube=8
3: square=9, cube=27
4: square=16, cube=64

assert captured_output == '1: square=1, cube=1
2: square=4, cube=8
3: square=9, cube=27
4: square=16, cube=64
5: square=25, cube=125

questions.topic: print() 函数的综合应用与格式化输出
questions.description: 用 format() 的位置与关键字参数输出。
questions.code_template:
name = "Bob"
age = 25
print("{} is {} years old".format(___, ___))
print("{n} will be {a} next year".format(n=___, a=___ + 1))
questions.expected_output:
Bob is 25 years old
Bob will be 26 next year
test_cases: assert captured_output == 'Bob is 25 years old\nBob will be 26 next year\n'

questions.solution:

age = 25
print("{} is {} years old".format(name, age))
print("{n} will be {a} next year".format(n=name, a=age + 1))
